title: Published to crates.io: autodyne 0.1.0, with the combo's full license expression
body: The user ran `cargo publish -p autodyne` on 2026-10-20: autodyne 0.1.0 is on crates.io (190 files, 707 KB), and crates.io accepted and shows the license as Tend renders it, GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Royalty-Free-1.0 OR LicenseRef-Commercial-1.0, so LicenseRef identifiers are fine there in practice (the Cargo reference's 'must be on the SPDX list' didn't stop it) and the GPL-only fallback and its graft aren't needed. Keywords and categories as set (audio, numerics, dsp, simd, signal-processing; mathematics, science, multimedia::audio, no-std). docs.rs builds it with the features in [package.metadata.docs.rs]. Later versions: bump the version in Cargo.toml, run the checks CI runs and `cargo publish --dry-run`, then publish.
